typography.instructions: Avoid Inter/Roboto for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk for structural authority and IBM Plex Sans for functional data reading. Only use bold/black weights for headers.

colors.instructions: Use #EA580C (Orange 600) exclusively for primary CTAs, active states, and progress bars. Keep the rest of the UI monochrome to ensure data clarity and accountability. No full-screen gradients. Borders must be sharp 1px solid lines.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders and Flat Solid. Do not use glassmorphism as this is an internal data app where legibility is critical.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use sharp 1px borders instead of drop shadows to define boundaries.
visual_enhancers.radius: Max 8px for outer containers, pill-shape (full) for primary CTAs only.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboards and developer tools.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI heavily customized. Avoid generic Vercel look. Strip shadows, use sharp 1px borders.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-orange-600 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-orange-700. Secondary: border border-zinc-900 bg-transparent text-zinc-900 rounded-none hover:bg-zinc-100.
components.inputs_and_forms: Shadcn Input, Select, Datepicker. Flat backgrounds, clear 1px borders.
components.tables: Dense rows. Sticky header. Status pills using text color and faint background.
components.cards: Cardless or sharp bordered. Remove default shadows from Shadcn cards.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense internal tool spacing. p-4 or p-6 for general containers.
grids_and_layouts.bento_mode: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for the Review Dashboard stat cards.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and data tables. Never center-align paragraphs or tabular data.
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Sidebar or top fixed header. Must use solid background to prevent overlap.

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions only. Hover states must have higher contrast.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform). Never use 'transition-all'.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain APCA / WCAG AA standards. Ensure hover/focus states are distinct.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).

login_background.description: Minimalist white office desk, to be used as a clean aesthetic backdrop for the login screen.

media.instructions: Use images sparingly. The app should feel data-driven.

3d_libraries.strategy: Not recommended for this internal ops app.
3d_libraries.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts for Review Dashboard charts (Daily Target Progress, Monthly Goal Progress). Keep charts flat and data-ink ratio high.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Recharts for dashboards: yarn add recharts
Ensure all components are `.js` or `.jsx`, do not create `.tsx` files.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively for complex interactions (Tables, Tabs, DatePickers, Dialogs, Select).
Build three main views: Targets & Goals, Task Management, Review Dashboard.
Task Management table must be rich and filterable.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for overlapping containers like dropdowns or sticky headers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through structured grids.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus).
Use sonner for toasts. Do NOT use standard alert().
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for automated testing.
